title: Attractor States Emerge in Multi-Turn LLM Conversations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating turn-level discourse traits such as flattery and agreement using an LLM judge to track whether models adopt their interlocutor's style or agree with them during multi-turn self-play and mixed-play debates.

Administering subjective and objective Likert-scale questionnaires after each turn to measure whether agents exhibit inherent, polarized positions on controversial topics when assigned a neutral 'Discussant' role.

Comparing in-character (subjective) stance questionnaires with third-person (objective) correctness assessments to isolate shifts in expressed position driven by assigned debate roles from underlying epistemic shifts.
